name: Highwater Farm Summer Youth Crew
what_you_do: Grow and sell vegetables on the nonprofit farm. You use hand tools like shovels, rakes and wheelbarrows. You do not need any farm or work experience. You join team activities, workshops and community events.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 17. You must be able to commit to the whole 7 weeks.
pay_detail: $15.16 per hour (2026), plus job training and fresh produce on set days.
duration: 7 weeks, Monday to Thursday, 8 AM to 3 PM (2026: June 15 to July 30)
deadline_text: 2026 positions are closed. The page says to check back in January 2027 for the next round of applications.
how_to_apply: The application will be on the program page in January 2027. Look for it then. Questions: savanna@highwaterfarm.org.
notes: Farm address: 7001 County Road 346, Silt, CO 81652. The 2027 pay rate is not posted. Page does not say which towns qualify.
